title: Cap the highway
summary: Keep I-95 in its trench and build a deck over it at street level from Atwells Ave to Westminster St when RIDOT rebuilds the bridges: about 150 homes from Atwells Ave to Broadway and a park from Broadway to Westminster St, with Broadway and Washington St crossing as ordinary streets.
author: Andy Chatham

next_decision.what: RIDOT starts designing the Connect Four bridges
